title: Figure 26: Nitinol shape-memory alloy stents beside a centimeter ruler
description: Photograph of two cylindrical mesh stents, one expanded and one compressed, standing above a ruler marked 2-4 cm. Caption: "Figure 26. Nitinol Stent. Nitinol is an alloy of titanium. It is biocompatible and also a shape memory material." It accompanies the 'Nitinol as a Biomaterial' section, followed by 'Contact Lenses'.
